readings.Aries: What you call impatience is actually high sensitivity to wasted potential. Channel it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: Security is not something you find. It is something you construct, slowly, from trustworthy materials. The first instinct was right.
readings.Gemini: The two things you want are not incompatible. You've been treating them as if they were. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Cancer: Something is asking to be mourned before it can be moved past. Let it. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: The thing you're proud of deserves to be shared. Not to impress — because it's genuinely good. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Virgo: Routine is not limitation. For you, it is the condition under which everything else becomes possible. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Libra: You are allowed to have a preference. Having one does not make you unfair. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: There is a version of this situation you haven't let yourself consider because it's too good. Consider it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Sagittarius: The journey you're on has been lonely at points. The loneliness is not a flaw in the journey. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Capricorn: The thing you're working toward is real. The price you're paying for it deserves examination. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Aquarius: The outlier in your data set is the most interesting part. Pay attention to it. Let this one be easy.
readings.Pisces: Your sensitivity is a precision instrument. It is currently tuned to everyone else's signal. What worked before will not work the same way this time.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
